notes.title: Benefits for istorm fans from other tank carrier game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Benefits for IStorm fans from other tank carrier game :
please send screenshot plus istorm game name to your facebook, and @istorm, or share the screenshot and game name in main military game forum，and reply with game link ,you will get award of  [b][u]15000 gold coin ,and 15 days VIP.[/u][/b]
(the content of screenshot should show us your love for such games,like achievements,medals,your R&D of vehicles,tech tree in your account )

PS:Please add the referrals(IStorm game name,only one ) with your game name ,so that both parts can get [b][u]2000 gold coin.[/u][/b]

the activity will valid until 31th,May,2017

------------------我是分割線-----------------------

戰友們好，5.1國際勞動節活動大狂歡。
其他載具類游戲玩家轉戰《IStorm》的專屬福利：
截圖+istorm遊戲名發送到妳的facebook並且@IStorm；或者把截圖+istorm遊戲名在各大軍事遊戲論壇宣傳，然後把連接回復在這裏可獲贈[b][u]15000金幣，vip15天。[/u][/b]
（截圖內容：其他載具類游戲帳號內的成就，勳章，研發車輛，載具樹……表現你對這類游戲的熱愛）

PS：發送IStorm遊戲名時註明推薦人（istorm暱稱）雙方可獲贈[b][u]2000金幣[/u][/b]（推薦人只能填一人）

活動有效期至2017年5月31日

notes.title: Announcement of IStorm game maintenance and update
notes.notes:
Dear player,
     In order to provide best game experience,our server will stop and have maintenance on April 27 (Thursday) 13: 00-14: 00 Beijing time.If this process can no be finished on time, the start time of server will be put off accordingly.More details are as follows:
player can not login the game during maintenance time.For any inconvenience ,we beg your forgiveness , and thank you for the support.

[b]Important update:[/b]
[olist][*]open level 1-5 main station tank, some annihilations and artilleries for D district ,
[*]open level 5 artillery, gold coins and aircraft AH-6G for M district
[*]open new map"Desert town"
[/olist]
[b]During May day holiday(Beijing time 2017.04.27-2017.05.08) :[/b]
[olist][*]players can get 2000G(3 days award for VIP)if players accumulation 2 hours fighting time per day.[/olist]
[b]Experience game optimization:[/b]
[olist][*]Stop the annihilation match and have maintenance of game function , the reopening time will be determined soon.
[*]NPC carrier will be back to battlefield.
[/olist]
[b]Server exception compensation:[/b]
[olist][*]for login exception on April 19,all the players will be compensated of 1000 gold coins and 3 days'vip.
[*]for sever disconnecting issue on April 21,all the player will be compensated of 1000 gold coins and 3 days' vip.
[/olist]

Moyi game
Istorm operation team

----------------------------------分割線-------------------------------------

尊敬的戰友們：
為了給大家帶來更好的遊戲體驗，本服務器將於北京時間的4月27日（週四）上午10：00-12:00進行停服維護，如未能按時完成，則開服時間順延，具體維護內容如下。
維護時間將暫時無法進入遊戲，給各位帶來的不便，還敬請諒解，非常感謝大家的支持！ （鞠躬）

[b]重要更新[/b]
[olist][*]開放D系1-5級的主站坦克，部分坦殲和火砲
[*]開放S系5級支援車，火砲，金幣車
[*]開放M系5級火砲，金幣車和飛機AH-6G
[*]開放新地圖《Desert town》[/olist]
[b]5.1國際勞動節活動（北京時間2017.04.27-2017.05.08）[/b]
[olist][*]每天累積戰鬥時間兩小時可獲得2000G，VIP3天獎勵。[/olist]
[b]體驗優化[/b]
[olist][*]關閉殲滅匹配，進行體驗和功能維護，再次開放時間待定。
[*]NPC戰車重回戰場，[/olist]
[b]服務器異常補償[/b]
[olist][*]4月19日登錄異常，補償全體戰友1000金幣，3天VIP；
[*]4月21日服務器異常斷開，補償全體戰友1000金幣，3天VIP。[/olist]

Moyi Game
《IStorm》運營團隊

notes.title: 《IStorm》New server bulletin
notes.notes:
Dear Players:
"IStorm" will open new PC platform server officially,on 14:00 pm on April 18(China Beijing time) ,via Steam.Plays can download "IStorm" through the Steam and login the game by then. Many welfare activities will start soon ,please arrange your time and inform each others.
 
New server time: April 18, 2017 14:00 to May 18, 2017 12:00
【Login gift】 During the event, login and sign-up ,you will gain double bonus.
【Battlefield reward】 During the event ,the experience, silver coins and other awards you win will double.
【Recharge benefits】 During the event, recharge gold coins ,and ready to be rebated equally.
【Store discount】 During the event, many items will be on discount.
【Armored lion】 During the event, members are recruited with gold coin .The chance of high-star members will be doubled.

"IStorm" operation team
April 17, 2017
